{{dablink|For the chapter in ''[[Towers of Midnight]]'' by the same name, see ''[[Towers of Midnight/Chapter 8|The Seven-Striped Lass]]''.}}
The '''Seven-Striped Lass''' is one of the finest taverns and kept clean. Located in western [[Caemlyn]], it busily caters to farmers and nobles.

[[Melli Craeb]] is the tavernkeeper and [[Berg]] is the tough doorman.{{ref/book|13|8}}

==Background==
Due to the name, it is was rumored that this tavern was a secret rendevous for high-ranking [[Aes Sedai]], maybe even the [[Amyrlin Seat]] herself.{{ref|[http://encyclopaedia-wot.org/geography/andor/caemlyn/seven.html EWoT page on the tavern]}}
